payload.description_html:
Ankylosaurid dinosaur Pinacosaurus from Upper Cretaceous of Bayan Mandahu, China (all specimens in IVPP). Oblique photograph of the Canada−China Dinosaur Project quarry in 1990 at Bayan Mandahu, China. Left: Quarry diagram showing the align − ment of juvenile skeletons, all of which were upright with limbs positioned

underneath their bodies.
